rules.name: Layered dependency clarity
rules.validation: Domain models, workflow, repository, adapters, and API entrypoint are separate modules.

rules.name: Ports before external adapters
rules.validation: Ports are declared for repository, audit, unit-of-work, and mock ecosystem adapter behavior.

rules.name: Command/query intent objects
rules.validation: Write and read workflows use explicit command/query dataclasses.

rules.name: Domain event traceability
rules.validation: Dispute creation and mock ecosystem checks emit local domain events into audit details.

rules.name: Typed application errors
rules.validation: Application errors expose stable error codes and structured response payloads.

rules.name: No live integration drift
rules.validation: Generated app and Phase 41 artifacts do not enable live UPI, bank, NPCI/RBI, PSP, payment rail, upstream, downstream, or third-party calls.

rules.name: No release operations
rules.validation: Deployment, merge, tag, and push actions remain disabled by policy and validator.
